paraphrase: There exists a two-world universal-accessibility frame with one individual, evaluated at one of its worlds, in which the stipulated world-invariant-filtered necessary-existence predicate holds but Scott's original unrestricted NE does not. The filtered part follows from its universal theorem, while failure of unrestricted NE follows from the earlier world-isolation characterization. The construction is mathematical; it is neither a metaphysically possible-world claim nor a refutation of necessary existence or God.
